A genuine operator decision pauses once and an idempotent answer continues the same intent.

implementation_notes: Reuse plugins#61; continue through the existing same-owner dispatch boundary only after verified settlement.
Do not convert planning-only graphs into executable runs; explicit execution admission remains separate.
No new scheduler or queue. Preserve original deadline, repair lineage, READY gating, decision fingerprints and held-claim recovery.
Live completion may execute an explicit validated one-step directive; direct recovery remains read-only and cannot replay it.
Fresh necessary READY tasks do not spend repair budget; repairs require exact current independently observed failure and retain original lineage/deadline.

nodes.title: Qualify the Codex Action Server adapter
acceptance: Adapter validates exact CAS input/output and nested structuredContent envelopes against pinned schemas.
One Factory attempt maps to one CAS request ID; lost replies never generate new dispatch keys.
Task reads use exact target, workspace, cwd, thread and turn, not loaded-thread absence.
Detached callback/approval limitations and descendant/terminal settlement are represented explicitly.
No workspace provisioning or daemon restart is hidden in a read.
